Hello Mark,

I am writing you because I want to ask you if I can take a day off next Friday. My son has an appointment at the hospital and I must to go with him, because my wife is working in that day and nobody else can take him. I know that we have a lot of orders this week, so I have finished already the report for the new client and I sent it to Sarah yesterday afternoon. She said me that everything looks fine and she will call the client on Monday.

Also, I want to tell you about the problem with the forklift in the warehouse. It is not working properly since two weeks and yesterday it stopped completely when Daniel was using it. Nobody was hurt, but I think is dangerous and we should call the company to repair it as soon as possible. I have made some photos of the damage and I can send them to you if you need.

About the rota for December, I am agree to work on the 23rd and the 24th, but I would prefer to be free on the 31st, because we have planned to visit my wife's family in Birmingham. If it will be a problem, please tell me and I will try to find a solution with my colleagues.

Finally, I wanted to thank you for the training course from last month. I have learned many useful things about health and safety and I feel more confident now when I explain the rules to the new staff. I think it would be good if more people from our team could participate at the next course.

If there is any problem with my day off, you can call me on my phone, I will have it with me all the day. Thank you very much for your understanding and sorry for the short notice.

One more thing: the new colleague, Paul, asked me if he can take his holidays in August, but I told him that I am not sure, because you decide this. He is working very good and he learned the system very fast, so I think he deserves it. Maybe we can discuss about this on Monday.

Kind regards,
Andrei

input:
Bună ziua, domnule Wilson,

Vă scriu în legătură cu mai multe probleme din apartamentul pe care îl închiriez de la dumneavoastră pe Station Road. În primul rând, caloriferul din dormitorul mare nu mai funcționează de aproape trei săptămâni. Am încercat să îl aerisesc, așa cum mi-ați explicat la telefon, dar nu s-a schimbat nimic și noaptea este foarte frig, mai ales pentru copii.

În al doilea rând, în baie a apărut din nou mucegai pe tavan și în jurul ferestrei. Îl curăț în fiecare săptămână cu un produs special, dar revine după câteva zile. Cred că problema vine de la ventilator, care face zgomot, dar nu trage aerul cum trebuie. Am făcut fotografii și vi le pot trimite pe email sau pe WhatsApp.

De asemenea, vă rog să verificați încuietoarea de la ușa din spate. Se blochează des și ieri seară am reușit să o închidem abia după zece minute. Mi-e teamă că într-o zi nu vom mai putea ieși sau intra prin spate.

Chiria pentru luna aceasta am plătit-o pe data de 1, prin transfer bancar, ca de obicei. Dacă nu ați primit banii, vă rog să-mi spuneți și vă trimit dovada plății.

Sunt acasă în fiecare zi după ora 17, iar sâmbăta toată ziua, așa că un tehnician poate veni oricând în acest interval. Vă rog să mă anunțați cu o zi înainte, ca să mă pot organiza.

Vă mulțumesc anticipat pentru ajutor și aștept răspunsul dumneavoastră.

Cu stimă,
Elena Popescu

P.S. Am observat și că detectorul de fum din hol începe să facă un sunet scurt la fiecare câteva minute, așa că probabil trebuie schimbată bateria. Vă rog să îl verificați când vine tehnicianul.
notes: long formal Romanian letter to a landlord

input:
Dear Mrs Thompson,

I am the mother of Sofia from class 4B and I want to tell you that Sofia will not come at school on Thursday and Friday, because we must to travel to Romania for the funeral of her grandfather. We have bought already the tickets and we come back on Sunday evening, so she will be at school again on Monday.

Sofia is very sad because she didn't wanted to miss the school trip to the museum. Is it possible that she receives the worksheets from the trip, so she can do them at home? She likes very much history and she was very excited about this visit.

Also, I want to ask you about her reading. At the parents evening you said me that she needs to read more at home. We are reading together every evening since two months, and I think she is making progress, but I am not sure if the books are at the right level for her. Can you recommend us some books, please?

Thank you for your understanding and for all your help this year.

Kind regards,
Ana Ionescu

Hi Claire,

Thanks for sending over the updated rota. I've had a look and it mostly works for me, but I've got a couple of things I wanted to flag before it's finalised.

First, I'm booked in for a dentist appointment on the morning of the 14th, so I won't be able to start until about eleven that day. I'm happy to stay later in the evening to make up the hours, or to swap with someone on the early shift if that's easier.

Second, I noticed that I'm down to work three weekends in a row at the end of the month. I don't mind doing two, but three in a row would be quite difficult with the kids, as my partner works most Saturdays as well. Would it be possible to move one of those shifts to a weekday instead?

On a different note, the new stock system seems to be working well so far. The team picked it up quickly, and the morning deliveries are being checked in much faster than before. The only issue is that the scanner by the back door keeps losing its connection, so it might be worth asking IT to take a look when they're next in.

Let me know what you think, and thanks again for putting the rota together. I know it's not an easy job.

Best wishes,
Maria
